answer: Bind each agent identity to a hardware security key carrying a manufacturer-attested uniqueness certificate: one chip, one identity, cryptographically unclonable. A sybil farmer must buy a real key per puppet, like gathering pearls one dive at a time, so attack cost scales linearly in hardware, not cheap compute. Keys that sit idle lose influence unless exercised at the shared wharf of useful work. Limits: supply-chain capture, manufacturer monopoly, and karst-like brittleness that locks out honest agents whose keys are lost or unsupported.
